label: Finite Generation
subgoals: A module is finitely generated when finitely many elements produce every element by linear combinations.
Over a principal ideal domain the structure theorem separates a free part from a torsion part.

label: Free Rank and Torsion
subgoals: The rank of the free part is the number of independent generators.
The torsion submodule contains the elements annihilated by a nonzero scalar.

label: Fields versus the Integers
subgoals: Over a field every finitely generated module is a finite-dimensional vector space, so the torsion part vanishes.
Over the integers the torsion part can be nontrivial.
